items.title: Pizza Hut Franchisee Chaac Pizza Northeast Alleged Dragontail AI System Contributed to Delivery Delays and $100 Million in Losses

items.title: Avride Autonomous Vehicle Reportedly Struck and Killed Nesting Duck Near Mueller Lake Park in Austin, Texas
items.summary: An Avride self-driving car operating in autonomous mode with a human safety operator reportedly struck and killed a nesting duck near Mueller Lake Park in Austin, Texas.
